headline: PSG and Liverpool win; Arsenal-Bayern unresolved here
paragraphs: Paris Saint-Germain beat Barcelona 4-2 in the Champions League on Tuesday, Vitinha and Fabian scoring late to end Barca's unbeaten start, according to Opta Analyst. Liverpool beat Villarreal 4-3 in another Anfield comeback, with Alexis Mac Allister and teenager Rio Ngumoha starring, also per Opta; the Guardian separately reports that Ngumoha's display excited Virgil van Dijk. Both scorelines are settled facts. PSG winger Khvicha Kvaratskhelia will have surgery after rupturing his ACL in the Barcelona game, confirmed by the club and reported independently by both Sky Sports and BBC Sport.

Barcelona have reported Paris Saint-Germain to UEFA over a tifo they say incited violence and hatred ahead of Tuesday's game; BBC Sport and Sky Sports both confirm the complaint, though Sky's item carried no further detail. Arsenal were away at Bayern Munich on Wednesday, with Bayern missing Joshua Kimmich after a death in his immediate family and Arsenal starting Noni Madueke ahead of Eberechi Eze, per Sky; no final score for that match appears in today's feed. Real Madrid's match against RB Leipzig was also underway and likewise unresolved here.

Beyond that it is still speculation. BBC's gossip column reports Harry Kane nearing a new Bayern contract and says Real Madrid remain interested in Arsenal's Riccardo Calafiori; neither claim is independently corroborated elsewhere in the feed. Transfermarkt separately links Real Madrid to an unnamed Arsenal player and a Fikayo Tomori return to the Premier League. At Man City, Phil Foden said, after reportedly scoring a hat-trick, that he still has 'a long way to go,' per Sky Transfers.
